summary: Discrepancy Between Received Parts and Work Order Display (Only One Part Appears Even Though Two Were Received)
reported_issue: On WO S-32 two DEF Fluid parts were received (with a vendor invoice number). The Vendor Invoices screen and vendor transaction history show both received, but the work order itself only displays one of the received parts; the second received part is missing.
expected_after_fix: The work order Parts view should display all received parts, consistent with the Vendor Invoices/vendor transaction records.
steps_i_followed: Booted SPA as admin (exact WO S-32 / Maktech is production data not present on staging; inferred repro by finding staging WOs where the same part was received multiple times).
Identified WOs with duplicate received parts via the list-requests-by-line API.
For WO S9-24182: API returned 4 received part_requests (2x '3.50-3.82... CLAMP' + 2x its Core); loaded the WO Parts tab and counted rendered description rows.
Repeated for WO S9-24176 (a part received 3 times).
Compared API received-part counts against UI-rendered rows.
actual_now: No discrepancy observed. Every received part renders on the work order. WO S9-24182: API=4 part_requests (all received, incl. both duplicate copies) => UI shows all 4 description rows. WO S9-24176: API total=3, received=3 => UI shows all 3 rows. Both duplicate received copies of the same part appear on the work order; none are dropped.
notes: Original WO S-32 not present on disposable staging shop. Tested the underlying symptom (multiple received units of the same part all displaying on the WO) on two staging WOs and found received-part count matches displayed rows in every case. Confidence medium since exact original record not reproducible.
